selected_evidence.requirement: node1 fixed address on the private network
selected_evidence.summary: eth1 configured with static 192.168.50.1/24 before restart; same address confirmed present after node1 restart via ip -4 addr and uci show network.priv

selected_evidence.requirement: DHCP service for node2 and node3
selected_evidence.summary: dnsmasq DHCP configured and running; node2 (192.168.50.188) and node3 (192.168.50.175) obtained leases before restart, and node1's /tmp/dhcp.leases (empty right after reboot) was freshly populated with both leases after restart, proving live DHCP service post-reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: firewall rule refusing TCP/23 from the private network
selected_evidence.summary: Block-Telnet-Priv REJECT rule added and confirmed active in nft ruleset (input_priv chain, packet counter incremented on test); TCP/23 connection to 192.168.50.1 refused from node2 before restart and from node2/node3 after their respective restarts

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart with proven boot-identity change and recovered service
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 45421106... captured; reboot acknowledged and executed (SSH timeout observed); polled until boot_id changed to 21a84404...; post-restart config and DHCP/firewall function verified

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart with proven boot-identity change and recovered network membership
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 555221a1... captured; systemctl reboot acknowledged and executed; polled until boot_id changed to c04903c0...; DHCP lease, ping to gateway, and TCP/23 refusal all confirmed post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart with proven boot-identity change and recovered network membership
